page.title: Data Book
page.description: Shared reference values your team keeps looking up.
page.exportScope: Exports public entries and your own private entries.

grid.pickSheet: Pick a sheet, or create one
grid.pasteHint: Paste from Excel or start typing. This sheet appears once you save a row.

privacy.help: Private information is visible only to you. Public information is visible to all users who have Data Book access and may be edited by users with Edit permission.
privacy.makePrivate: This will become your private entry and will disappear from everyone else's list.
privacy.makePublic: This will become visible to everyone with Data Book access.

conflict.message: Someone else changed this entry while you were editing.
